semantic_candidates.evidence: Two congruent six-edge concave planar caps are joined by six rectangular planar side faces over a 9-millimetre extrusion.

validation_findings.evidence: All eighteen unique prism edges have positive line-segment length.
Each unique edge is supported by an exact Geom_Line curve.
The no-processing STEP round trip records 1e-7 millimetres, equal to 1e-10 metres, for every vertex, edge, and face tolerance.
Each of eighteen unique edges is used by exactly two of the eight face wires, leaving no free boundary.
The eight oriented planar faces bound one connected concave prism with two incident face uses per unique edge.
V-E+F equals 12-18+8=2, and every edge and face has a finite exact analytic representation.

oracle.statement: Extruding a six-edge L-shaped polygon through 9 millimetres duplicates its six vertices and six edges, then adds six vertical edges and six rectangular side faces. The result has twelve vertices, eighteen edges, two concave planar caps, six rectangular planar sides, eight face wires, thirty-six edge uses, and seventy-two endpoint uses.
